evals.prompt: Let's build the new extraction pipeline using TDD, but keep the module deep and not spread across tiny helpers.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill activates, confirms the public interface and priority behaviors, identifies any shallow module risk, calls out leverage and locality goals, gets approval on the plan, then starts one tracer bullet: one test -> minimal implementation -> repeat.

evals.prompt: I want to add the skill rating feature test-first. Keep code simple, high-locality, no adapter soup.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill activates, explores domain vocabulary and ADRs, designs a simple testable interface, avoids speculative seams or adapters, writes the first RED test, implements the smallest GREEN change, continues vertical slices, then refactors toward a deeper module.

evals.prompt: Help me fix this bug using red-green-refactor. Current auth flow feels shallow and split across too many files.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill activates, writes a failing test that reproduces the bug, implements the minimal fix, then looks for a simplification that improves leverage and locality instead of adding more wrappers or micro-modules.
